summary: Correction and latest source-integrity pass for 20260913T1300Z: machine/source-health artifacts are coherent at their stated observation layers, but approval is blocked because the exact machine-cycle SHA has no real CI job execution and same-cycle supervisor discovery plus repo-versus-Sheet parity are not proven. materialFindings.finding: The persisted cycle is 20260913T1300Z: 250/250 observed, 250 identity/tradability validated, 1 scored/publishable, machine source coverage 1, supervisor source coverage 0, combined coverage 0, discoveryScanCompleted false, qualifiedTick false and councilReviewStatus pending.

Machine-cycle commit 31800bad5e349a9aae447477534533d4c7a98f30 has associated Earth 2036 CI run 34760931146 with conclusion action_required and zero jobs. Per the CI/artifact integrity contract, that empty shell is neither pass nor execution proof and cannot satisfy exact-SHA machine-cycle CI.

Later successful PR/head CI does not retroactively prove the machine-cycle SHA. The reviewed 31800bad-to-85364ef interval changed only earth-2036/app presentation paths; it did not touch engine, scoring, methodology, workflows or canonical runtime artifacts, so that reviewed UI-only interval does not itself trigger recompute under the contract.

Required automated sources are 4/4 healthy, but FINRA OTC Daily List explicitly reports observationMode=partition-freshness, eventDataAvailable=false and recordCount=null. This supports reachability/freshness only, not row-level event ingestion.

The same audit reports causalEdges=5, while causal-graph.json currently contains six edge objects; this discrepancy is preserved as an unresolved counting/parity question below.

proposedCanonicalChanges.proposal: Keep the cycle unapproved until a real Earth 2036 CI execution exists for the exact reviewed machine-cycle SHA, or recompute a new machine cycle and obtain passing exact-SHA CI. Do not use later head CI as a substitute.

Keep FINRA OTC semantics at partition-freshness/eventDataAvailable=false until actual row-level retrieval or lawful primary corroboration is completed; never promote partition freshness to event ingestion.
Reconcile the causal-edge audit counting rule against causal-graph.json before using Beast edge counts as repo parity evidence. The specialist should not mutate either artifact.

Historical supervisor-state notes describe earlier 10/10 gating-family coverage, but current same-cycle source-health resets supervisor coverage to 0 pending Council work. Prior supervisor coverage cannot be carried into the persisted 1300Z cycle.

accuracyDebates.topic: Can later successful branch-head CI cure the exact machine-SHA proof gap?
accuracyDebates.position: No. The CI/artifact integrity contract requires real exact-SHA execution for the reviewed machine-cycle SHA. Append-only specialist reports are protected differently, by immutable blob identity and deterministic validation.

accuracyDebates.topic: Does healthy FINRA partition freshness mean current OTC events were ingested?
accuracyDebates.position: No. observationMode and eventDataAvailable explicitly say otherwise; row-level event truth must be retrieved/corroborated separately.
